en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Jameel Bin Darraj, from Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Muslim who said,

‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> was asked, and I was present, about the Ethiopian chicken (Turkey), coming out with it from the Al-Harram. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘It does no fly around with the birds’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Jamil ibn Darraj from Muhammad ibn Muslim who has said the following: “

Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, was asked, when I was present, about the Ethiopian chicken if it can be taken out of al-Haram (the sacred area). He (the Imam) said, ‘Its flight is not independent.’”
